turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, and why wasn't I called before my son's mark was changed?
I don't think this is productive.
Not productive? You put a zero on my son's record, and I'm asking who decided it and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You asked for this meeting, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I will, and it won't be the only thing I send. But you're not walking out of here without telling me who decided and on what basis.
